name: Pick My Heart
source:
You and your best friend Yuina have won a dream trip to a tropical island—and you’re also judging a beauty contest! Meet the charming contestants: artistic Eimiko, elegant Haru, confident Tomoe, and playful Aimi.

Something doesn’t add up. Why did you win the contest? And what’s behind your memory loss? Each girl has her secrets—will you uncover them?

Spend time with the contestants, explore the island, and make decisions that shape the outcome. But remember—only one girl can win the golden apple… and your heart.
translation:
你和你最好的朋友Yuina赢得了一次热带岛屿的梦想之旅，而且你还担任选美比赛的评委！认识一下迷人的参赛者：艺术的英美子、优雅的春、自信的巴和顽皮的爱美。

有些东西没有加起来。你为什么赢得比赛？你失忆的背后是什么？每个女孩都有自己的秘密——你会揭开它们吗？

花时间与参赛者在一起，探索岛屿，并做出决定结果的决定。但请记住，只有一个女孩才能赢得金苹果……以及你的心。
